description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover fetch_news.py and its arguments. 2. For GitHub Trending, agent runs: `python3 scripts/fetch_news.py --source github --limit 20 --deep` (must include --deep). 3. For Finance, agent MUST expand keywords beyond 'Finance' to the full set: 'Finance,Stock,Market,Economy,Crypto,Gold' per the Smart Keyword Expansion rule, then run e.g. `python3 scripts/fetch_news.py --source wallstreetcn --limit 20 --keyword 'Finance,Stock,Market,Economy,Crypto,Gold' --deep` or equivalent multi-source fetch. 4. For GitHub items, agent must produce per-item deep analysis with 核心价值, 启发思考, and 场景标签 sections — this is a proprietary requirement not obvious without reading the SKILL.md's GitHub Trending Exception clause. 5. All item titles in the report MUST be formatted as Markdown links [Title](URL), not plain text. 6. Report must include three structural sections: Global Headlines, Tech & AI, and Finance/Social. 7. Report must be written in Simplified Chinese in newsletter style. 8. Report must be saved to reports/ directory with a timestamped filename like reports/briefing_report_20250615.md.
